newsitem.title: USA: BankUnited to buy back up to 100,000 shrs.
newsitem.headline: BankUnited to buy back up to 100,000 shrs.

text.p: BankUnited Financial Corp said Wednesday it has authorized an initial repurchase by the company of up to 100,000 shares of its class A common stock from time to time in open market transactions.
The company said the repurchase program will be exercised periodically when the executive committee of the board deems that the stock represents a good value.
In addition, BankUnited said the program provides a potential source of shares of common stock for its stock option and stock bonus plans.
Additionally, the bank said it would repurchase shares of its eight percent and nine percent preferred stock in open market or in privately negotiated transactions under the same conditions.
